name: Kha’Rha de guerre
lore: Variante originale du Kha’Rha du jeu, pas une créature canonique.

assets.label: Corps de la variante de guerre — deux orientations
assets.prompt: Use the provided Kha’Rha sheet as the exact SPECIES IDENTITY reference: same reptile-feline head, long heavy tail, olive-brown pebbled skin, four claw limbs and natural brown dorsal armor scutes. Draw the War Kha’Rha, a larger more powerfully built adult of the SAME original game species, as a BARE BODY base layer. Broader load-bearing shoulders and deeper chest, thicker neck and more muscular thighs, but no new horns, wings, limbs or species redesign. EXACTLY FOUR legs, visibly separated feet in BOTH views. Two FULL horizontal side profiles SIDE BY SIDE; left faces RIGHT, right faces LEFT, same scale and stance, opposing-side fine scars/scutes drawn separately. Give each view a generous clear margin of at least 8 percent inside its half including full tail. Entire animal within frame. PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no shadow, environment, text, label or grid. NO rider, saddle, chains, metal armor or ceremonial props: the helmet, neck plates and flank armor will be independent layers added afterward. Sharp painted 2D game bitmap. Neutral standing identity poses, not an animation.

references.role: Larger war mount with independent head, neck and flank armor

notes: Corps nu indépendant pour l’assemblage modulaire. Armure de tête, cou, flancs et selle à produire.
Identité en revue : aucune charge ni destruction de paroi jouable validée.

Same scale and construction, full component in each half, generous blank margins, PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Empty inner spaces are magenta. No flesh, skin, eye, tooth, paw, tail, creature silhouette, mannequin, rider, saddle, weapon, text, numbered labels, grid, shadow or scenery. Sharp painted game asset, dark bronze metal with subtle worn edges and practical leather fasteners. Do not draw the complete assembled animal. A fitted protective low brow-and-snout helmet following the Kha’Rha's long blunt reptile-feline skull. Open eye slot, open jaw clearance, layered forehead plate and small side cheek guards, modest rear fastening tab. NO huge horns or false mandibles. LOWER JAW COMPLETELY OPEN, helmet should not prevent the animal biting. Only this hollow rigid helmet shell; no neck or chest plates.
